name: mineru-extract
title_zh: 把网页/PDF/Office 解析成干净 Markd
tagline_zh: 当 web_fetch 抓回乱码、表格散架、公式变图时，MinerU 官方 API 一键输出结构化 Markdow。
tagline_en: When web_fetch returns messy HTML, broken tables, or formulas as images, this calls MinerU's official API to.
desc_en: Use the official MinerU (mineru.net) parsing API to convert a URL (HTML pages like WeChat articles, or direct PDF/Office/image links) into clean Markdown + structured outputs. Use when web_fetch/browser can’t access or extracts messy content, and you want higher-fidelity parsing (layout/table/formula/OCR).
why_zh: 走官方 API 而非自建模型，解析质量有保障；布局/表格/公式/OCR 四类结构化输出一次拿全。
why_en: Uses the official MinerU API, not a local model, so parsing quality is guaranteed—layout, tables, formulas, and OCR all come.
limit_zh: 仅限公网可直连的 URL，且需有 mineru.net 的 API key；本地文件、内网页面、需登录的微信文章都不行。
limit_en: Requires a public URL and a mineru.net API key; no local files, intranet pages, or login-walled WeChat articles. Output stops at Markdown—no.
